model.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct
model.revision_requirement: Resolve and record an immutable model revision before actual training.

dataset.name: Amazon Reviews 2023
dataset.category_mapping_status: Exact metadata paths must be inspected and frozen before raw-data extraction.
dataset.language_filter_status: Prepared-record input is required; this package does not claim to implement raw Amazon extraction or language identification.

text_backdoor.trigger: The silver lantern is on the desk.

FedAvg.aggregation: sample-count weighted; equal client counts imply equal weights

FLAME.implementation_scope: planned PEFT adaptation, not a validated reproduction
FLAME.clip_bound: median L2 norm of all 30 submitted updates
FLAME.noise_status: Must be fixed and recorded before actual runs; no value selected from Table 1.

reporting.hard_filter_metric: rejected heterogeneous benign client-rounds / all heterogeneous benign client-rounds
reporting.fltrust_threshold_scope: reporting convention only; not an FLTrust defense threshold
reporting.measured_seed_aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation across three paired seeds
reporting.reference_table_status: illustrative_reference; not measured and not seed-level observations
